entities.summary: Masjid Haji Yusoff is a mosque located off Upper Serangoon Road in Hougang, Singapore. Built in 1921 and completely reconstructed in the 1990s, the mosque is named after its main benefactor, Haji Eusoff. It was also the former campus of Madrasah Al-Arabiah Al-Islamiah until after 1982.
